segments.text: HOUSTON: Oil prices settled higher on Friday as Hurricane Isaias churned toward the northern Gulf of Mexico and oil companies shut more than 70 percent of crude production in US waters.

Earlier in the session, crude prices were down as US President Donald Trump said talks with Iran to end the war in the Middle East had been “productive.” Trump also teased an upcoming, undisclosed announcement on diesel and said he was cons
Brent crude futures settled at USD104.72, up 44 cents or 0.42 percent. US West Texas Intermediate crude futures finished at USD91.85 a barrel, up 36 cents, or 0.39 percent.

newsDocuments.headline: Trump says Putin agrees to major release of diesel to US, global markets

segments.text: WASHINGTON, United States: US President Donald Trump said Friday that he had secured Russian leader Vladimir Putin’s agreement to release diesel into US and global markets, vowing this will help cool surging energy costs amid war with Iran.
“Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 Tons of Diesel Fuel to the American and Global Marketplace,” Trump said on social media after talks with Putin.
The US Treasury Department issued a temporary license to enable Russian diesel to flow to global markets through April 2027.

newsDocuments.headline: Trump says Russia to supply diesel to US and global market

segments.text: WASHINGTON: President Donald Trump said on Friday ‌that Russia had agreed to immediately supply more than 300,000 tons of diesel to the US and global marketplace in an effort aimed at cutting prices for the fuel ahead of the November midter

The move comes as prices of diesel, used in agriculture, heating homes and trucking goods, are near record highs ahead of the November 3 congressional ​elections that will determine control of Congress.
Trump said in a post on social media he had a “highly successful” discussion with President ​Vladimir Putin in which they agreed that Russia will immediately supply the diesel.

newsDocuments.headline: Govt cuts petrol price by Re0.66, raises diesel by Re0.52 per litre

segments.text: The government reduced the price of petrol by Re0.66 to Rs398.30 per litre, while increasing the price of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Re0.52 to Rs396.24 per litre, effective from Saturday, October 10, 2026.

The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) revised on Friday the ex-depot prices of petroleum products under the federal government’s petroleum pricing mechanism, according to a notification issued by the Petroleum Division.
The Petroleum Division said the change was necessitated by global developments, including movements in Platts rates, premiums and incidentals.
